newsitem.title: USA: Crescent Real Estate buys Texas offices.
newsitem.headline: Crescent Real Estate buys Texas offices.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Inc said on Monday it completed its acquisition of the Greenway Plaza office portfolio in Houston, for $206 million.
The company said it acquired 10 office buildings with a total of 4.3 million square feet and a 74 percent occupancy located in a mixed-use development near downtown Houston.
The purchase was funded through the issuance of 599,332 shares of common stock, the assumption of $115 million of mortgage debt and $66 million of cash, it said.
Crescent also said that on October 1, Parsons Process Group signed a six year lease for 170,000 square feet there.
